chunks: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated in what a group informed us about, from Abu al-Mufaddal al-Shaybani from him, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umair; and a group also informed us from several of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umair, from Umar ibn Azina, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays, who said: I heard Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Tayyar say:

We were with Muawiyah: I, al-Hasan, al-Husayn (peace be upon them), Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Umm Salama, and Usama ibn Zayd. An argument arose between me and Muawiyah, so I said to him: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say: 'I am more entitled to the believers than themselves. Then my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib is more entitled to the believers than themselves. When Ali is martyred, al-Hasan is more entitled to the believers than themselves. When al-Hasan passes away, al-Husayn is more entitled to the believers than themselves. When he is martyred, his son Ali ibn al-Husayn is more entitled to the believers than themselves. And you will meet him, O Ali. Then his son Muhammad ibn Ali is more entitled to the believers than themselves, O Ali. Then they will be completed to twelve Imams, nine of whom are from the descendants of al-Husayn.'
Abdullah ibn Ja'far said: Al-Hasan, al-Husayn, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Umar ibn Umm Salama, and Usama ibn Zayd were martyred, and they testified for me before Muawiyah.
Sulaym ibn Qays said: And I heard this from Salman, Abu Dharr, and al-Miqdad. And they mentioned that they heard it from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia belief regarding the number and lineage of the Imams according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Sulaym ibn Qays, transmitted via Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Tayyar, serves as a foundational proof for the doctrine of Imamate by linking the Prophet's declaration directly to the Twelve Imams. It highlights the political and spiritual legitimacy of the Ahl al-Bayt during the Umayyad era, with Ibn Ja'far testifying before Muawiyah to validate the succession line starting with Ali and culminating in twelve Imams, nine of whom are from Husayn's progeny. The report also notes the corroborating testimony of prominent companions like Salman, Abu Dharr, and al-Miqdad, reinforcing its authenticity in Shia scholarship.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 101 - Narrated Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Ja’far Himyari that a group of scholars informed that Abu Mufaddal Shaibani narrated from his father from Muhammad bin Husain from Muhammad bin Husain from Muhammad bin Abi Umair. Also narrated to us a group of scholars from Muhammad bin Yaqub from Muhammad bin Yahya from Ahmad bin Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umair from Umar bin Uzniyya from Aban bin Abi Ayyash from Sulaym bin Qays that: I heard Abdullah bin Ja’far Tayyar [husband of Zainab] say: We were in the company of Muawiyah: I, Hasan, Husain, Abdullah bin Abbas, Umar bin Umme Salma and Usamah bin Zaid when an argument arose between us; I said to him: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say: “I have more authority on the believers than they have on themselves.

After me, my brother Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s) has more authority on the believers than themselves. When Ali (a.s) is martyred, Hasan Ibn Ali (a.s) will have more authority on the believers than themselves, followed by my son Husain (a.s), who will have more authority on the believers than themselves. When Husain (a.s) is martyred, his son, Ali Ibn Husain (a.s) will have more authority on the believers than themselves. O Ali! Soon you will meet him. Then his son Muhammad Ibn Ali will have more authority on the believers than themselves. Thereafter, the Messenger of Allah (s) completed the list of twelve Imams, nine of whom will be from the descendants of Husain (a.s).”
Abdullah Ibn Ja’far continues, ‘I sought testimony from Hasan, Husain, Abdullah Ibn Abbas, Umar Ibn Umm Salma and Usamah Ibn Zaid and they all verified my statement before Muawiyah.’
Sulaym bin Qays says, ‘And indeed I heard the same from Salman, Abu Zar and Miqdad and they in turn heard it from the Messenger of Allah (s).
